description: FY67 AH-1G block c/n 20133; owned by Vietnam Veterans of America Chapter 467 (Baugher; Aerial Visuals) and displayed outdoors with an armoured personnel carrier beside the Vietnam Veterans Museum at Chaffee Crossing where it is viewable at any time while the museum itself is by appointment (479-478-0110); satellite imagery shows the Cobra and vehicles on the lawn and a user photosphere of Apr 2021 shows the AH-1 and APC; variant as displayed not verified and could be an AH-1S rebuild
museum_name: Fort Chaffee Vietnam Veterans Museum -- Chaffee Crossing
